business_problem: IBM's Chief Sustainability Office was fielding growing volumes of complex sustainability-data requests, but fragmented systems and manual research slowed seller support and limited the team's ability to scale.
solution_summary: IBM built AskSustainability as an AI-powered agent so sustainability expertise could be delivered on demand instead of through ad hoc specialist work. The solution uses IBM watsonx.ai and IBM watsonx Orchestrate to act as an institutional expert over sustainability metrics, policies and client-specific product carbon-footprint data. Rather than forcing sellers or internal teams to search multiple fragmented systems, the agent provides trusted natural-language answers from a centralized knowledge base and plugs into the places where users already work, including AskSales, AskIBM and Slack. This design combines knowledge retrieval, response automation and workflow distribution in a single operating model: watsonx.ai supports the answer-generation layer, watsonx Orchestrate enables the agent behavior and delivery, and the surrounding hubs expose the capability broadly across IBM. The result is a sales- and operations-facing sustainability assistant that turns specialist knowledge into a scalable self-service asset.

solution_components.name: IBM watsonx.ai
solution_components.role: Generates trusted natural-language responses over sustainability metrics, policies and product-footprint data.

solution_components.name: IBM watsonx Orchestrate
solution_components.role: Runs the AskSustainability agent and helps distribute it across IBM's existing work hubs.

data_flow: Sustainability metrics, policies and client-specific product carbon-footprint data are centralized for AskSustainability, watsonx.ai generates the response, and the agent is delivered through AskSales, AskIBM and Slack where users consume the answers.
business_outcome: AskSustainability reduced response times from days to seconds, supported a meaningful portion of IBM's seller pipeline and gave the sustainability office a scalable way to support both revenue and compliance-oriented data requests.
metrics: $50M in sales pipeline influenced in the first four months
50 data sources unified into one conversational experience
architecture_clues: The agent is positioned as an institutional expert rather than only a search interface.
Integration into AskSales, AskIBM and Slack was part of the initial rollout, not a later add-on.
The solution focuses on trusted data such as operational metrics, policies and product carbon footprints.
evidence_quotes: an estimated $50 million in sales pipeline
Automated responses reduced turnaround times from days to seconds
